character: Thermal spa town known since antiquity. Largest ski resort in Ariège — Ax 3 Domaines (80km, 37 runs, 3 sectors). Free natural thermal hot springs on rue des Thermes (36-78°C). Casino, cinema, ice rink. Lush Pyrenean valley setting.
description: Ax-les-Thermes is a thermal spa town in the Ariège Pyrenees known since Roman times for its natural hot springs. The famous free public thermal springs on rue des Thermes (36-78°C) are a unique attraction. Ax 3 Domaines is the largest ski resort in Ariège: 80km of pistes across 3 sectors — Bonascre (village level), Saquet (mid-altitude), and Campels (high altitude, 2,400m). 37 runs. Snow activities: snake gliss (4.5km toboggan), fat bike on snow, igloo construction, ski touring. Bains du Couloubret for paid thermal bathing. Casino Joa, ice skating rink, cinema. Gateway to the Ariège Pyrenees — Orlu valley, Chioula pass, Beille plateau.

non_ski_activities.hot_springs: Free natural thermal springs on rue des Thermes — 36-78°C water. Unique free public access. Bains du Couloubret (paid) for formal thermal bathing experience.
non_ski_activities.snake_gliss: 4.5km toboggan descent from 2,000m to 1,400m through fir trees. With Bureau des Guides.
non_ski_activities.fat_bike: Fat bike on snow — wide-wheel bikes. Available through guides.
non_ski_activities.bonascre_baths: Bonascre Baths — Scandinavian-style wellness evening at altitude.
non_ski_activities.igloo_village: Igloo construction workshops. With Bureau des Guides.
non_ski_activities.casino: Casino Joa — slot machines and gaming in a friendly setting.
non_ski_activities.other: Ice skating rink, cinema (Cinémax), hiking (Laurenti pond, Comte pond, Dent d'Orlu), snowshoeing, ski touring, Orlu valley, Chioula pass, Beille plateau.

honest_drawbacks: Low altitude village (720m) — snow variable at base
